security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost media: http://media.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob: thumb: http://thumb.localhost media: http://media.localhost; media-src 'self' blob: media: http://media.localhost; frame-src 'self' http://page.localhost page:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data: http://font.localhost font:; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Fast dark-mode file explorer with smart thumbnails and treemaps
bundle.longDescription: Alt File Explorer is a portable, keyboard-first file browser with smart media thumbnails, fuzzy search, quick previews and a treemap visualization of folder contents.
